title: Hoshino Ichika — Starry Steps〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, what time is today's practice session again... I still have a while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll just practice my part for now, then. Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (There are puddles outside. Must have been because of the rain that fell before I went to bed.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Rain...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This reminds me of Saki when she was still in hospital.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (She always stared sadly outside the window when it rained. But once she noticed me, she'd then smile so brightly.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I'm really so happy Saki recovered from that.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah, I wonder if the florist along the way to the hospital is still around?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I always passed by that shop when going to visit her, so I often bought flowers from them...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But I haven't been there since Saki was transferred to a regional hospital during junior high.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Since I have some time before practice starts...
Maybe I'll just drop by to take a look.
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Found it! Hehe...
It hasn't changed at all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Maybe the florist lady is still around...)

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Are you looking for flowers? Please step inside.
We have many more different types of... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Is that... Is that you, Ichika?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah... You remember me?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Of course I do! But you were just a little elementary school kid back then, weren't you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I'm in high school now.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Well! You've really grown up.
I always knew you were keeping well somewhere out there.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Anyway, how can I help you today?
Are you here to get flowers for another hospital visit?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I'm just passing by today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, the friend I used to visit has recovered, and we're attending the same high school now.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: That's excellent news!

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: I was actually quite concerned about the friend you were visiting, and whether she would be okay.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
You visit her almost every day, remember?
I thought her condition had to be quite bad for you to do that.

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
So I'm glad to hear she's doing fine.
She must have been really strong to beat her illness like that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I think so, too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sorry, but can you make me a small little bouquet? Just like before?

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line:
Of course I can.
Hehe, and I'll even give you a discount. For old times' sake.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Florist Lady
rows.Line: Don't you worry about it. We haven't seen each other in so long, and I got to hear good news about your friend too. Wait here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. Thank you.
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah... You're already here, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I wanted to practice by myself first.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? What's that bag in your hand, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, does it look familiar?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um, is that a flower logo? Oh!
It's from that florist you always bought flowers from when you visited me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Correct. I bought some flowers there before coming here. It's been a long time, though.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, this really brings back memories!
Can I see them?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here. Oh, the lady at the florist shop gave me this yellow flower for free.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She asked me to bring you to the shop one day, too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You know, when I was in the hospital, I always looked forward to seeing what flowers you would bring.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They were always a little bit different from the previous ones, and every single one would be so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I would choose the best flowers together with the florist lady so that they could make Saki smile.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ichi, I really want to visit that florist shop!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure. Shall we go together with Honami and Shiho one day?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, why don't we put those flowers here as decorations?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Pretty sure they'd make Miku and Luka really glad, too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're right. Let's bring along a vase or something to put the flowers in, then, next time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Will do!
